messages:
elaine_cs: Heads-up — ACME reported their org showed 0 credits for ~10m during the midnight refill window (CET). They saw a bunch of 429s and then everything auto-refilled. Customer is worried about failed live demos.

john_infra: Can you paste the org id and example request ids?

elaine_cs: org=acme-prod-17, example req id `req_2026-03-16T23:58:12Z_aa12`. They sent a long-running streaming job; got immediate 429s on reconnects. UI showed 0. Billing API later shows bucket full.

arjun_billing: Thanks. Likely refill happened in billing service at UTC midnight, but cache layer (token-service cache) might have stale TTL and returned zero until invalidation.

john_infra: Repro ideas: 1) Simulate websocket retry loop during refill window 2) Force cache hit on token-service 3) Watch billing service publish event.

elaine_cs: Repro steps customer provided: - open websocket stream, consume tokens for ~20m - disconnect and reconnect between 23:57-00:02 CET - reconnect receives 429 until ~00:08 CET when calls succeed.

sre_bot: Created INC-2026-453 for investigation and linked logs.

john_infra: From logs: token-service returned `available_tokens: 0` at 2026-03-16T23:58:30Z, billing service updated bucket at 2026-03-17T00:00:01Z, cache eviction only happened at 2026-03-17T00:07:12Z. So looks like cache TTL + eventual eviction race.

arjun_billing: Workarounds: - manual cache purge for acme-prod-17 (can do now) - short-term: increase token-service cache refresh to 30s during refill window - long-term: listen to billing publish events to proactively invalidate cache.

elaine_cs: Customer asked if this is DST-related. They are CET but DST just changed for them. Any DST link?

john_infra: Unlikely DST — we schedule refill at UTC midnight. But display/UI timezone conversions can confuse customers. The root cause is cache TTL not being tied to billing update events.

arjun_billing: I'll run the manual purge now and follow up here once done.

arjun_billing: Done — cache purge for org acme-prod-17 succeeded at 2026-03-17T00:10:03Z. Customer confirmed UI tokens back and reconnects succeeded.

elaine_cs: Customer confirmed demos resumed. They requested an RCA and ETA for permanent fix.

john_infra: Next steps: (1) Instrument billing->token-service event bridge (2) add a short-circuit check in token-service: if billing reports refill within last 5m, prefer authoritative value over cache (3) add a runbook for manual purge during midnight windows. I'll open a PR and assign.

arjun_billing: Filed infra task INFRA-1298. Target patch next sprint; hotfix options if customer needs SLA credit.

elaine_cs: Thanks team — I'll update the customer with the workaround and ETA. :thumbsup:
